description: Directory dataset. Use when an agent needs a paged export or change feed of verified PageVerified directory facts. Cost: 10 credits per call.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Keep category and since unchanged. If matching data changes, restart without a cursor.

format.description: json (default) or csv. CSV remains inside the JSON response envelope.

limit.description: 1–500 rows; defaults to 500. Each successful page costs 10 credits, including an empty page.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp with timezone; includes rows verified OR updated at or after it.

name: directory_dataset
